arguments.question: Assess whether commodity-linked inputs, component pricing, capacity commitments, or supply constraints are material to ANET over the 5/21/63-session horizon. Use only substantive issuer supply-chain and inventory/purchase-commitment disclosures in the registered 2026 filing/results excerpts; do not infer direct copper, energy, semiconductor, or freight sensitivity without evidence. Identify the operating-to-margin/cash-flow mechanism, competing explanations such as strategic buffering versus demand weakness, and observable disclosure changes that would alter the case. Stop after registered issuer evidence; if commodity pass-through or component weights are unquantified, state that narrow limitation rather than searching broadly.
arguments.decision_impact: Determines whether input-cost and supply commitments create an incremental near-term margin/cash-flow risk or are merely an unquantified conditional channel, completing the mandated commodities role without overstating commodity exposure.
